# Problem 1 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

options(tibble.pring_min = 5)

transit_df = read_csv (file = "./data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data",
                       na=c("NA",".","")) |>
janitor::clean_names()|>

select(transit_df,line, station, name, station_latitude, station_longitude,route1, route2, route3, route4, route5, route6, route7, route8, route9, route10, route11, entrance, ada) |>
  
mutate (transit_df, entry = 
          case_match(
            entry, 
            "YES" ~ "TRUE",
            "NO" ~ "FALSE"),
          )
  
```
